title: Napoleon Wasn't Short. A Cartoon Made Him Short 📏
caption:
Napoleon wasn't short 📏
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. Napoleon was about 1.69 m (5 ft 7), around average for a Frenchman of his time. The "tiny Napoleon" idea came partly from French inches being longer than English inches, and from British cartoonists who drew him as "Little Boney".
What other history "fact" is fake? 👇
first_comment: Two hundred years of short jokes because of a unit conversion and a grumpy cartoonist. 📏👇
